sources.title: 鼎固控股有限公司 - MoneyDJ理財網
sources.note: Describes 鼎固 as 「日月光集團在大陸轉投資的房地產開發商」; it does not identify a formal parent or provide ownership details.

sources.title: About ASE | ASE
sources.locator: 「Who We Are and What We Do」
sources.note: ASE states it is a member of ASE Technology Holding Company, establishing the ASE/holding-company relationship but not 鼎固-KY's relationship to that group.

sources.title: ISE Labs Investment Secures the Establishment of New Site for Semiconductor Packaging and Test in Mexico | ASE Holdings
sources.locator: Paragraph beginning “ISE Labs focuses on semiconductor engineering”; About ASE, Inc.
sources.note: ASE states that ISE Labs is a wholly owned subsidiary of ASE Technology Holding Company, “the largest semiconductor assembly and test provider in the world.” This is the company's own description; it does not specify a ranking metric or market denominator.

sources.title: Chinese firms gain ground in 2024 top 10 OSAT ranking
sources.locator: Article opening and ASE ranking paragraphs
sources.note: Reports, citing a TrendForce report, that ASE led the 2024 global top-10 OSAT ranking with US$18.54 billion revenue, nearly 45% of the top ten's combined revenue. Ranking is by OSAT revenue; the cited comparison is the top ten, not all possible packaging/test operations.

search_notes: Isolated Hermes Agent run using gpt-6-luna with xhigh reasoning and web tools.
Eight focused research turns were used. The OSAT ranking is supported within the stated scope; the exact 鼎固-KY parent-company relationship remains unresolved.
The parent-group attribution is not confirmed by an ownership filing or other primary ownership disclosure found in this research.

The largest-provider claim is supported for the OSAT provider context; the ranking evidence is revenue-based and compares the global top ten, not every semiconductor company's in-house packaging and test operations.
The Chinese term 封測廠 commonly refers to a packaging-and-test company/provider; these sources do not establish that the claim refers to a single physical factory.
